description: This file defines functions and types related to managing Ollama models, including URL building, querying model context window, enriching models with context, and fetching model tags. It also exports types for models and responses.

methods.name: buildOllamaBaseUrlSsrFPolicy
methods.description: Builds a security policy for SSR fetch based on the provided base URL.

methods.name: resolveOllamaApiBase
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL for Ollama, removing trailing slashes and version suffix.

methods.name: queryOllamaContextWindow
methods.description: Queries the context window size for a specific Ollama model via API.

methods.name: enrichOllamaModelsWithContext
methods.description: Enriches a list of models with their respective context window sizes.

methods.name: isReasoningModelHeuristic
methods.description: Determines if a model ID likely indicates a reasoning model based on heuristic regex matching.

methods.name: buildOllamaModelDefinition
methods.description: Creates a model definition configuration object with heuristic reasoning detection.

methods.name: fetchOllamaModels
methods.description: Fetches available Ollama models from the API and indicates if the server is reachable.
